name: Adaptive Sneak
description:
Control how and when sneaking switches between 'toggle' and 'hold' modes.

 - Single press the sneak key to toggle crouching. (Disables double press activation)
 - Double press the sneak key to toggle crouching. (Disables single press activation)
 - Hold the sneak key for momentary crouching (will override the toggled state if active).

NOTE: If single-press activation is enabled, the hold threshold determines how long the key must be held to trigger momentary crouching.
